## Skills (procedures)

| Skill | Use when |
|---|---|
| `ai-film-treatment` | Write the treatment and the story, character and world bible for the route the owner picked, and the shot list that feeds shot specs. Use after the pick, before any shot spec or generation. |
| `brand-identity` | Procedure for a brand identity job in the harness (channel or studio brand: name lockup, logo, palette, DP, banner, kit). Agency structure with gates B0-B8, exactly 3 researched routes, mechanical checks and blind critics. Use for any logo, |
| `channel-launch` | Launch a new channel that has zero posts. Runs the 12-step Channel Launch workflow (brief, research, competitor evidence, positioning, pillars, formats, packaging, production system, 30-post calendar, measurement and review), with human loc |
| `channel-strategy` | Research and position a zero-post channel. Category and audience research, competitor evidence from actual posts and videos, post-level deconstruction, an opportunity and positioning hypothesis, then the channel promise and editorial voice. |
| `competitor-watch` | Track and compare competitors or comparable studios and channels with dated, measured cards and honest limits. Use for a recurring watch or a one-off competitor study; paid data only with an approved quote. |
| `content-programming` | Turn a locked positioning into a programme: 3 to 5 distinct pillars, repeatable formats and series, a packaging system (title, hook, thumbnail or cover, caption, CTA), a production system, and the first 30-post calendar with a 90-day strate |
| `content-routes` | Produce three genuinely different routes (safe, brave, wild) with an axis table, blind scores and a contrarian pass, then present the best two for the owner's pick. Use after the research pack and before any treatment. |
| `operating-loop` | The Studio Harness operating loop for every job that produces a deliverable (channel plan, competitor or channel research, brand, banner, logo, thumbnail, script, reel, film, 3D video, post series, growth plan). Finds or opens the run, work |
| `packaging` | Prepare titles, thumbnails, captions, platform requirements and a calendar draft as a social package for the owner to publish by hand. Never posts, schedules or messages. |
| `project-closeout` | Close a run. Writes the closeout record, sets the status honestly, and hands lesson candidates to the memory-curator. Promotion to shared memory is never part of closeout itself. |
| `qa` | Run independent QA and rights review on a run and write the qa-report with a PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN verdict. The reviewer must not be the agent that produced the work. |
| `research-pack` | Build a dated, evidence-led research pack with a validated source ledger and at least eight real references examined and measured. Use after the brief, before any route is written. |
| `shot-spec` | Write one complete, checkable specification per shot and move it through draft, approved_to_generate, generated and qa_passed. Use after the treatment and shot list; never generate before an approved paid_generation row exists. |
| `studio-brief` | Start a project. Declares the context, captures the brief in the owner's exact words, states business logic and success measure, creates the run folder from runs/_template, and lists the approvals needed up front. Use at the start of any ne |

## External tools

| Tool | Kind | Cost | Can | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `yt-dlp` | cli | free | public YouTube/Instagram metadata, playlists, transcripts where available, video files for analysis | channel-analyst, reference-forensics, trend-scout |
| `ffmpeg` | cli | free | frames, contact sheets, cuts, loudness (ebur128), encodes | reference-forensics, motion-editor, voice-producer, qa-rights-reviewer |
| `python3` | cli | free | validators, hooks, catalog, measurement scripts (stdlib) | all |
| `blender` | app | free | deterministic 3D scenes via bpy, previews, renders | animation-3d-lead, blender-cinematographer |
| `node` | cli | free | Remotion programmatic video, captions | motion-editor |
| `git` | cli | free | versioned runs and releases | chief-engineer |
| `youtube-data-api` | api | byo-key | channel and video statistics, uploads list, comments (quota-limited) | channel-analyst, analytics-analyst |
| `platform-analytics-exports` | file | free | YouTube Studio / Instagram Insights CSV exports or screenshots the owner provides | analytics-analyst |
| `image-video-models` | service | free-first; paid needs quote | image, image-to-video, reference-to-video, text-to-video through whatever MCP connector or web tool the owner has; routing in policies/model-routing.yaml | ai-generation-artist, ai-film-lead |
| `tts-voice` | service | free-first; paid needs quote | voice-over generation or a human VO plan | voice-producer |
| `after-effects-premiere` | app | owner licence | compositing and timeline work via scripting (optional) | motion-editor |
| `vidiq` | connector | paid (quote + owner yes) | outliers, keyword research, competitor stats (account-bound; test before promising) | channel-analyst, youtube-strategist |
